data.name: Cry Wolf
data.detailed_description:
Cry Wolf reinvents the classic Werewolf party game for multiplayer. On small maps where every corner matters, suspicion spreads fast: who's lying, who's manipulating, and who's hiding among you?

How to Play

Each match brings together 6 to 20 players, secretly split between villagers and werewolves. By day, discuss, accuse, and vote. By night, the wolves strike in the shadows. The village must unmask and eliminate every wolf before it's too late but a single surviving wolf is enough to make the other side lose.

Brand-New Roles

Beyond the genre's classic roles, Cry Wolf introduces original mechanics that completely change how you play:

  • Friend / Enemy - designates a player who will die in their place, or vice versa.

  • The Gambler - bets on a player's survival: gain votes if they die, loses votes if they survive.

  • The Detective - discovers who a player voted for, valuable information for cutting through the lies.

A Brand-New Team System

Players no longer face off alone: entire teams can win together by eliminating the opposing side. But watch out if a single werewolf remains alive, they win alone, even against their own team.

Features

  • 6 to 20 players per room

  • Built-in voice chat

  • Multiple playable maps

  • Base roles + brand-new roles (Friend/Enemy, Gambler, Detective...)

  • Customizable skins

Who's lying? Who's playing both sides? Who can you trust when night falls? Join Cry Wolf and find out for yourself.

data.short_description: Cry Wolf is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf, where secret alliances, risky bets, and new roles turn the classic rules upside down. Face 5 to 19 other players over voice chat across varied maps and unmask the wolves before it's too late.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian
